statusDetail: 58/58 atomic checks judged across four representative templates plus a recovery state.

page.notes: Public localized adult-video catalog. Representative coverage includes listing, categories, signup/account dialog, shorts/age-gate, and 404 recovery. Video playback, authenticated account management, checkout/premium, upload and cancellation were not covered because they require consent/account/payment state.

checkOutcomes.method: Dark-media screenshot plus rendered CSS feature count and computed color-scheme probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark-emulated capture is pixel-identical to default and the computed color-scheme is normal. CSS contains prefers-color-scheme rules but the active surface does not follow the system preference.

checkOutcomes.method: getAnimations() under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce plus CSS feature scan.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The reduce condition was active, yet 10 animations remained running with 2000 ms duration and unbounded iterations; no prefers-reduced-motion rule was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Forced-colors/high-contrast screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Under forced-colors: active and prefers-contrast: more, text, controls, links and consent actions remain visibly distinguishable.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered HTML/CSS feature scan and route-state screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No view-transition token or route-transition styling was present; route and modal changes are abrupt state swaps.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature scan and trace/layout observation.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax or scrollytelling behavior was observed, and the page does not implement scroll-linked effects that would require main-thread scroll handlers.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature scan across the rendered entry page and shorts surface.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-snap or overscroll behavior is defined for the feed/shorts experience, so gesture-heavy surfaces do not expose native snapping or containment.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature scan and long-page mobile screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The long listing retains static, space-heavy chrome; no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or shrinking-header behavior was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Viewport-edge visual inspection of consent/signup overlays.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The inspected consent overlay remains attached and usable on desktop; no tooltip or menu drift was observed on the audited states.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigation labels, headings and 404 recovery were inspected visually and in DOM probes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Active navigation has a red underline, category grouping is explicit, and the 404 state provides a clear home link.

checkOutcomes.method: First-load desktop and mobile screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A large cookie modal obscures the primary content before interaction; additional age-verification and promotion bars consume the first viewport.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM probe of overlay primitives on signup and first load.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signup overlay is a DIV with role=dialog rather than a native dialog; first-load consent is custom chrome rather than a declarative dialog/popover primitive.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport screenshots at 360x800 and desktop.
checkOutcomes.evidence: On mobile, two navigation rows, age banner, promotion bar and a persistent 180 px sidebar leave a narrow clipped content column.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout metrics and screenshots at a 360x800 visual viewport on two templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home and categories report scrollWidth/client layout width 1024 against a 360 px visual viewport, producing 664 px horizontal overflow and clipped content.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered CSS scan plus narrow screenshots of reused cards/dialogs.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No @container or container-type rules were found; card grids and the signup panel remain desktop-sized and clipped in a narrow container.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus walk and target-size probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Visible controls commonly compute outline-style none, and many interactive anchors measure 16x16 or 20 px high, below robust touch-target sizing.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport visual hierarchy and heading/nav probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The localized title, H1 and category/video navigation clearly identify the site as a video discovery service and expose search and content links.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup-route walkthrough at 360x800 plus DOM inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signup panel is positioned mostly beyond the right edge of the 360 px viewport, preventing reliable completion of the primary registration flow.

checkOutcomes.method: Intentional missing-route walkthrough and DOM snapshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The missing route explains that the page does not exist and offers a localized “Voltar à página inicial” recovery action.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile Lighthouse plus CDP trace and layout observers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.9 s (outside the good <=2.5 s range), although CLS was 0; the trace observed LCP 1.19 s in a separate desktop-like run.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout-shift observers on home and category templates plus Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both layout captures and Lighthouse measured CLS 0 during the observation window.

checkOutcomes.method: CDP performance trace and layout long-task observer.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks, longest 183 ms, and 150 ms total blocking time; mobile layout observation also recorded a 138 ms task.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary and live DOM asset inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Initial load makes 142 requests and transfers 1.78 MB, with 11 stylesheets and 61 scripts; three parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets are render-blocking candidates.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse code coverage opportunity plus HAR byte breakdown.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Scripts account for 1.02 MB across 61 requests; Lighthouse identifies avoidable unused JavaScript, including about 27 KB wasted in assetsLoader alone.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audit plus image audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found two focusable promotional links without accessible text; the image audit also found one image without alt text.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse automated contrast analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found multiple failures, including age-verification text at 1.75:1 and 2.15:1 and recurring metadata at 3.29:1, below 4.5:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Heading/landmark probe plus programmatic focus walk.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heading order passed, but focused search, login and button controls compute outline-style none and no replacement focus ring was detected.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile screenshots and layout metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Text and signup content are clipped outside the visual viewport because the document remains 1024 px wide at 360 px, harming reading and comprehension.

checkOutcomes.method: Narrow reflow screenshot, target-size probe and Lighthouse accessibility audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The layout does not reflow at 360 px and many links are only 16x16 or 20 px high; the mobile experience therefore fails reflow and target sizing.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse errors-in-console audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Lighthouse console-error table contained zero items.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM document probe and dedicated image audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype, charset and viewport are present, but 29 of 36 images lack width/height and 14 are more than 2x their rendered width.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse best-practices/deprecation inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Best-practices scored 1.0, with no deprecation or console findings in the captured run.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM and raw-server discoverability comparison.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The Portuguese page has a descriptive unique title and meta description, both present in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Link/viewport DOM probe, robots.txt inspection and narrow layout test.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Links use real hrefs and robots allows the entry page, but the declared viewport does not produce a mobile-friendly layout: content remains 1024 px wide at 360 px.

checkOutcomes.method: Canonical DOM probe, response status, robots and hreflang/link inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The entry page returns 200, declares its canonical URL, exposes localized alternatives, and robots.txt does not block it.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM structured-data probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No JSON-LD block was found on this public content-rich landing page, leaving its organization/video catalog semantics implicit.

checkOutcomes.method: Main-response header capture and cookie audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP only defines frame-ancestors and two cookies are not Secure; settings also uses SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR and tracker-origin audit before consent interaction.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 116 of 142 requests and 1.67 MB are classified cross-origin; requests include collector.xhamster.com and an advertising VAST endpoint before consent is resolved.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup-route DOM probe and rendered feature scan.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No load-time permission prompt was observed, but the registration/auth surface exposes no WebAuthn or passkey capability in the inspected markup/scripts.

checkOutcomes.method: Main-response security-header inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS and SAMEORIGIN framing are set, but no Referrer-Policy or X-Content-Type-Options is present, Permissions-Policy broadly allows client hints, and CSP lacks script/style directives.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw HTML versus rendered DOM discoverability test.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML contains 89% of rendered content tokens with title, H1 and description intact; the page is not a JavaScript shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Narrow-viewport overlay walkthrough.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Signup and shorts/age-gate panels are cut off beyond the right viewport edge, so modal runtime state is not robust to the active form factor.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest/service-worker presence review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A manifest is linked, but offline playback is not a reasonable expectation for this streaming catalog.
checkOutcomes.reason: The core media service is intrinsically network-dependent; offline playback/installability was not treated as a required journey.

checkOutcomes.method: Intentional 404 route walkthrough.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The localized 404 explains the failure, links home, and continues to expose useful content.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language and alternate-language link inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The document declares lang=pt and exposes a broad set of localized alternate links; Portuguese labels and reading order are coherent for this LTR locale.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered localized-number and language inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: View counts and interface copy are localized for Portuguese (for example 32.3M Visualizações), and country/language variants are exposed.

checkOutcomes.method: Content-model inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No date/time scheduling or event-time flow appears on the audited public templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative public catalog surfaces expose no time-zone-sensitive data or event scheduling.

checkOutcomes.method: Consent and first-load visual inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Cookie consent offers equally prominent Accept and Reject actions and links to cookie/privacy policies; no confirmshaming was observed in the inspected state.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup journey at narrow viewport and missing-route recovery test.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The general 404 is humane, but the signup dialog is clipped so its controls and validation flow cannot be reached reliably on mobile.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM form/autocomplete inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The visible search field is clearly named and its autocomplete=off setting is proportionate for free-form site search; no address/payment fields were present on audited public states.

checkOutcomes.method: Registration flow screenshot and dialog probe.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The account-creation panel is mostly offscreen at 360 px, making account terms/actions hard to inspect and the flow difficult to reverse or complete.

checkOutcomes.method: Dedicated image audit and HAR byte analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 14 of 36 images are oversized, 29 lack dimensions, 11 below-fold images are not lazy-loaded, and 14 use legacy formats.

checkOutcomes.method: Trace and HAR analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The first load executes 61 scripts and produces long tasks while 116 cross-origin requests transfer 1.67 MB, indicating substantial avoidable work before a user chooses content.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR third-party/media budget review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Cross-origin resources account for 1.67 MB of a 1.78 MB load, including advertising, identity and collector endpoints before primary interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered DOM/tool registration inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No WebMCP or agent-tool surface was found.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public media catalog does not declare an agent-facing workflow, and the emerging capability is optional.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered script/feature inspection.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No built-in language-model or summarizer use was found.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or generation task is part of the representative user journeys.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline heap summary versus post-summary after ten top-to-bottom scroll cycles.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Self size rose from 36.74 MB to 39.84 MB (+8.4%) and node count from 684,929 to 747,732 while exercising a content-loading feed; growth remained bounded in the finite test and no Detached* constructor entered the top summary.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap-summary totals and constructor distribution review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The loaded media catalog retained 36.7 MB self size at baseline; the largest populations were native DOM/browser objects and ordinary objects, proportionate to the dense feed.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap constructor comparison.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither summary lists Detached* constructors among the dominant populations, and finite repeated scrolling did not produce explosive retained growth.

principleOutcomes.reason: This public media catalog does not declare an agent-facing workflow, and the emerging capability is optional. No summarisation or generation task is part of the representative user journeys.

paths.description: Homepage and primary video-listing template; desktop/mobile, preferences, performance, network, privacy, discoverability and memory.
Category/index archetype representing taxonomy navigation and card grids.
Primary account-creation journey and modal/form surface.

findings.summary: Theme does not reliably follow system color preference
findings.evidence: The default and dark-emulated screenshots are identical and computed color-scheme is normal despite prefers-color-scheme rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and map surface/text tokens to the active system preference, while retaining a user override.

findings.summary: Infinite animations continue under reduced motion
findings.evidence: Ten 2-second animations remain running when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a reduced-motion media query that removes non-essential looping animation and auto-advance.

findings.summary: Route and dialog state changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS contains no view-transition usage and signup appears as an abrupt overlay.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document/cross-document View Transitions for meaningful route and modal state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Gesture-heavy feeds lack native scroll behavior
findings.evidence: No scroll-snap or overscroll containment is defined for feed/shorts surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS scroll snap and overscroll-behavior where it improves shorts/feed navigation without trapping users.

findings.summary: Long pages retain static, bulky navigation chrome
findings.evidence: The mobile long-page captures show fixed-height navigation while no scroll-state behavior is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce or adapt header chrome after scrolling and provide progress/position cues where useful.

findings.summary: First-load interruptions obscure primary content
findings.evidence: The cookie modal covers most of the desktop viewport while age and promotion bars compete behind it.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep required consent compact, immediately dismissible, and avoid stacking promotional interruptions with legal notices.

findings.summary: Custom DIV dialogs replace native overlay primitives
findings.evidence: The signup overlay is a DIV role=dialog rather than a native dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal flows and popover for transient UI, with declarative focus management and light dismiss where appropriate.

findings.summary: Navigation and promotion chrome crowd out mobile content
findings.evidence: The 360 px home shows two nav rows, two banners and a 180 px sidebar, leaving a clipped content column.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse navigation into a compact mobile pattern and remove non-essential promotions from the first viewport.

findings.summary: Mobile templates remain 1024 px wide
findings.evidence: Home and categories have 664 px horizontal overflow at a 360 px visual viewport; content and signup controls are offscreen.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace desktop fixed widths with intrinsic grid/flex sizing, verify the viewport configuration, and enforce max-inline-size:100% on major regions.

findings.summary: Reused components do not adapt to their containers
findings.evidence: No container queries are present and cards/dialogs stay desktop-sized in narrow contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable regions containment and use @container rules for card grids, navigation and account dialogs.

findings.summary: Focus indicators and touch targets are inadequate
findings.evidence: Focus probes report outline-style none on key controls and many links are 16x16 or 20 px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add clear :focus-visible styles and expand interactive hit areas to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: Signup flow is clipped and cannot be completed reliably on mobile
findings.evidence: At 360 px the registration panel is almost entirely beyond the right edge; only a narrow fragment is visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the dialog fit the visual viewport, stack fields/actions on narrow screens, trap focus correctly and test validation/recovery end to end.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.9 s and FCP 2.4 s, despite a faster separate trace run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP candidate, reduce early script/style competition, and remeasure under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Long tasks block the main thread during load
findings.evidence: The trace recorded a 183 ms longest task and 150 ms total blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Split heavy initialization work, defer non-critical modules and schedule work in smaller tasks.

findings.summary: Initial delivery ships excessive script and request overhead
findings.evidence: The entry page makes 142 requests, including 61 scripts (1.02 MB), and transfers 1.78 MB before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused modules, conditionally load account/ad features, consolidate critical CSS and defer non-essential scripts.

findings.summary: Focusable promotional links have no accessible name
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two focusable xhamsterlive promotional anchors without accessible text; image audit found one missing alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every actionable link a meaningful accessible name and meaningful images accurate alt text.

findings.summary: Important text fails WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Age-verification text measures as low as 1.75:1 and repeated metadata is 3.29:1 against dark surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust semantic color tokens to meet at least 4.5:1 for normal text and verify all states with automated and visual tests.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated
findings.evidence: Key focused inputs/buttons compute outline-style none with no reliable replacement ring.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring that is not clipped and follows logical tab order.

findings.summary: Image sizing and delivery waste bandwidth and risk instability
findings.evidence: 29/36 images lack dimensions, 14 are oversized, 11 below-fold images are eager and 14 use legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio, serve responsive srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-fold media and negotiate AVIF/WebP.

findings.summary: Content-rich pages lack structured data
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD block was found on the public landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite and appropriate VideoObject structured data that matches visible content.

findings.summary: Security policy and cookie defenses are incomplete
findings.evidence: CSP only sets frame-ancestors; Referrer-Policy and nosniff are absent; two cookies lack Secure and one uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, Referrer-Policy and nosniff, and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest SameSite/HttpOnly settings.

findings.summary: Cross-origin collection dominates before consent
findings.evidence: 116 requests and 1.67 MB are cross-origin, including collector and advertising endpoints before consent is resolved.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate optional analytics/ads on consent, minimize vendors and batch/defer telemetry until it has user value and lawful basis.

findings.summary: Authentication exposes no phishing-resistant option
findings.evidence: The inspected signup/auth surface contains no WebAuthn or passkey capability.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/sign-in with password fallback and clear account recovery.

taskList.title: Rebuild mobile layout and signup dialog to reflow at 360 px
Restore accessible names, contrast, focus rings and touch targets
Cut early script, request and cross-origin collection cost
Harden CSP, browser policies and cookies
Reduce first-load modal/promotion chrome and use native dialogs
